episodes.title: Le journal du matin, mardi 20 octobre
episodes.headline_en: Partial curfews came into force on Monday evening in Paris, Lyon, Lille and Nice, after the violence of 17 October
summary_en: Partial curfews came into force on Monday evening in Paris, Lyon, Lille and Nice, after the violence of 17 October
In Australia, a member of parliament was deliberately run over by a driver, and Prime Minister Anthony Albanese says it was a deliberate act
Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu says the curfews contributed to the calm of the night and that new ones will be decided this evening where the situation requires

episodes.title: Le sport, mardi 20 octobre
episodes.headline_en: Football: Paris Saint-Germain host FC Barcelona at the Parc des Princes this Tuesday, for the third round of the Champions League league phase
summary_en: Football: Paris Saint-Germain host FC Barcelona at the Parc des Princes this Tuesday, for the third round of the Champions League league phase
Football: FC Barcelona face Real Madrid in the Clasico on Sunday, and the Barcelona president Joan Laporta criticised Real Madrid's recruitment

summary_en: Marseille: showers, 17 to 22 degrees, wind up to 28 kilometres an hour
